sikandar.en: Sikandar Lodī, the sultan of Delhi (1489–1517)

hari.en: Hari, the Lord (a name of Viṣṇu)

karmā.en: Karmā, the mother of Saint Ravidāsa

māḍur.hi: माडुर, काशीके पास संत रविदासजीका स्थान
māḍur.en: Māḍur, the place near Kāśī where Saint Ravidāsa lived

rāhū.en: Rāhū, the father of Saint Ravidāsa

yogāvatī.hi: योगावती, श्रेष्ठ क्षत्रिय वंशकी एक स्त्री, जिन्होंने मीराके साथ रविदासजीको गुरु बनाया
yogāvatī.en: Yogāvatī, a woman of a noble kṣatriya line who, with Mīrā, took Ravidāsa as her guru
